name: Autonomy
description: Autonomous operation, operator assistance and machine intelligence in offroad applications.
strategicRelevance: Relevant for future operator environment, cabin intelligence and safety-related use cases.
recommendedAction: Monitor customer programs and connect autonomy signals to R&D and Product Management.

name: Electrification
description: Electrified offroad machinery, electric architectures and related cabin or seating requirements.
strategicRelevance: Relevant for future seat electronics, power integration, thermal comfort and energy-efficient cabin systems.
recommendedAction: Track customer electrification roadmaps and identify implications for GRAMMER product concepts.

name: Operator Comfort
description: Ergonomics, seating comfort, premium operator environment and productivity-related comfort features.
strategicRelevance: Relevant for customer differentiation, premium seating, cabin upgrades and sales arguments.
recommendedAction: Use comfort-related evidence in customer profiles and sales enablement discussions.

name: Digital HMI
description: Digital cockpit, sensors, HMI, smart interfaces and connected operator interaction.
strategicRelevance: Relevant for integrated cabin concepts, smart seating and future operator interface design.
recommendedAction: Connect HMI signals to technology intelligence and evaluate integration potential with cabin systems.

name: Sustainable Materials
description: Recycled, bio-based, lightweight and lower-emission materials for seating and cabin applications.
strategicRelevance: Relevant for CSR, customer sustainability requirements and future material positioning.
recommendedAction: Connect sustainability evidence with CSR, R&D and customer-specific material discussions.

name: Localization
description: Regional sourcing, local production, supply chain localization and market-specific customer requirements.
strategicRelevance: Relevant for India, China, regional sourcing decisions and customer footprint strategies.
recommendedAction: Track localization signals and connect them to customer opportunities and competitive risks.
